description:
As part of its ongoing commitment to community service, the Rotary Club of Mumbai Ghatkopar West extended monthly support to Rajaram Patil Old Age Home through a contribution of ₹5,000, generously sponsored by Prabhat Roadways. The donation was utilized towards providing essential food and medicines for 32 senior citizens, helping ensure their daily nutritional and healthcare needs were met.

This monthly initiative reflects Rotary’s spirit of Service Above Self by bringing care, dignity, and support to elderly residents who depend on such assistance.
